key_provisions_or_claims: Commission inspections show compliance rate stable at about 80% since 2010.
18 initial airport inspections and 2 appropriate authority inspections in 2022; no Article 15 cases or infringement proceedings.
Cybersecurity, access control and cabin baggage screening flagged as weak implementation areas.
Drone threats to airports addressed via Drone Strategy 2.0 and counter-UAS risk assessment.
Trials of automatic prohibited item detection; international cooperation with ICAO, US and CASE II.
annotation.summary_en: Commission's annual report on implementing Regulation (EC) 300/2008 on civil aviation security in 2022. It covers inspections, compliance rates, legislative updates, trials, cybersecurity, threat outlook including unlawful drone use, and international dialogue. Only passing reference to drones; not about AI.
